# packages/types — Lean Context (see llms-full.txt for full interface definitions)

Shared TypeScript type definitions for the MBE monorepo.

## src/venue.ts

interface VenueGroup { id, name, slug, settings, createdAt }
interface Venue { id, venueGroupId, venueGroup?, name, slug, ianaTimezone, currencyCode, operatingHours, settings, createdAt, updatedAt }
interface OperatingHours { monday?..sunday?: DaySchedule }
interface DaySchedule { open: string, close: string, closed?: boolean }
interface PacingRule { maxCoversPerSlot, timeWindowMinutes? }
interface DurationRule { minPartySize, maxPartySize, durationMinutes }
interface VenueSettings { defaultReservationDuration?, maxPartySize?, minAdvanceBooking?, maxAdvanceBooking?, requirePhone?, requireEmail?, confirmationEmailEnabled?, reminderEmailEnabled?, slotIntervalMinutes?, lastSeatingBuffer?, holdDurationMinutes?, pacingRules?, durationRules? }
interface CreateVenueGroupRequest { name, slug, settings? }
interface UpdateVenueGroupRequest { name?, slug?, settings? }
interface CreateVenueRequest { venueGroupId?, name, slug, ianaTimezone, currencyCode?, operatingHours?, settings? }
interface UpdateVenueRequest { venueGroupId?, name?, slug?, ianaTimezone?, currencyCode?, operatingHours?, settings? }

## src/user.ts

interface UserPreferences { theme?: "light"|"dark"|"system", emailNotifications?, marketingEmails? }
interface User { id, email, name, picture, emailVerified, preferences, createdAt, updatedAt }
interface UserProfile { id, name, picture }
interface CreateUserRequest { email, name?, picture? }
interface UpdateUserRequest { name?, picture? }
interface UpdatePreferencesRequest { theme?, emailNotifications?, marketingEmails? }

## src/reservation.ts

type ReservationStatus = "PENDING" | "CONFIRMED" | "CANCELLED" | "COMPLETED" | "NO_SHOW"
type TableStatus = "AVAILABLE" | "OCCUPIED" | "DIRTY" | "READY"
interface Table { id, name, tableNumber, capacity, minCovers, maxCovers, location, isActive, priority, status, venueId, floorPlanId, shapeMetadata, createdAt, updatedAt }
interface Reservation { id, date, startTime, endTime, partySize, status, notes, cancellationReason, cancellationNote, guestName, guestEmail, guestPhone, guestId, userId, tableId, table?, venueId, createdAt, updatedAt }
interface CreateReservationRequest { date, startTime, endTime, partySize, tableId, notes?, guestName?, guestEmail?, guestPhone?, guestId?, venueId? }
interface UpdateReservationRequest { date?, startTime?, endTime?, partySize?, tableId?, status?, notes?, cancellationReason?, cancellationNote? }
interface UpdateTableStatusRequest { status: TableStatus }
interface WalkInRequest { partySize, tableId, venueId, guestName?, durationMinutes? }
interface CreateTableRequest { name, tableNumber?, capacity, minCovers?, maxCovers?, location?, priority?, venueId?, floorPlanId?, shapeMetadata? }
interface UpdateTableRequest { name?, tableNumber?, capacity?, minCovers?, maxCovers?, location?, isActive?, priority?, floorPlanId?, shapeMetadata? }

## src/guest.ts

interface Guest { id, venueId, venue?, email, phone, name, notes, visitCount, lifetimeSpend, lastVisit, tags, reservations?, createdAt, updatedAt }
interface CreateGuestRequest { venueId, email?, phone?, name, notes?, tags? }
interface UpdateGuestRequest { email?, phone?, name?, notes?, tags? }
interface GuestSearchParams { venueId, query?, tags?, hasNotVisitedInDays?, minVisitCount?, maxVisitCount? }
interface GuestSegment { name, description, count, guests? }

## src/floor-plan.ts

interface FloorPlan { id, venueId, name, isActive, layoutJson, tables?, createdAt, updatedAt }
interface FloorPlanLayout { width, height, backgroundImage?, gridSize?, showGrid? }
interface TableShapeMetadata { x, y, width, height, rotation?, shape: "rectangle"|"circle"|"square", color? }
interface CreateFloorPlanRequest { venueId, name, isActive?, layoutJson }
interface UpdateFloorPlanRequest { name?, isActive?, layoutJson? }
interface UpdateTablePositionRequest { tableId, shapeMetadata }
interface BulkUpdateTablePositionsRequest { floorPlanId, positions }

## src/availability.ts

interface TimeSlot { time: string, available: boolean, tables?: AvailableTable[] }
interface AvailableTable { id, name, capacity, minCovers, maxCovers }
interface DateAvailability { date, hasAvailability, slotCount? }
interface AvailabilityQuery { date, partySize, duration? }
interface DateRangeQuery { startDate, endDate, partySize }
interface ReservationHold { id, venueId, tableId, date, startTime, endTime, partySize, sessionId, expiresAt, createdAt }
interface CreateHoldRequest { venueId, date, time, partySize, tableId? }
interface ConfirmHoldRequest { guestName?, guestEmail?, guestPhone?, guestId?, notes? }
interface ConflictCheckResult { hasConflict, conflictingReservationId?, conflictingHoldId? }
interface PacingCheckResult { withinLimit, currentCovers, maxCovers }

## src/api.ts

interface ApiResponse<T> { data: T, meta?: ApiMeta }
interface ApiMeta { timestamp, requestId? }
interface ApiError { error, message, statusCode, details?, type?, title?, status?, detail?, instance? }
interface ProblemDetails { type, title, status, detail, instance? }
function createProblemDetails(status, title, detail, type?, instance?, extensions?): ProblemDetails & ApiError
interface PaginatedResponse<T> extends ApiResponse<T[]> { pagination: Pagination }
interface Pagination { page, limit, total, totalPages, hasNext, hasPrev }
interface HealthResponse { status: "ok"|"degraded"|"error", version, timestamp, service?, checks? }
interface HealthCheck { name, status: "ok"|"error", message?, durationMs? }
type SystemStatus = "healthy" | "degraded" | "unhealthy" | "unknown"
interface SystemHealthResponse { status, timestamp, services, staticSites, ci, deploy }
interface SubsystemHealth { status, version, url, checks, updated_at }
interface ServiceCheck { name, status, message?, durationMs? }

## src/schema-compat.ts

interface SchemaChange { type: "breaking"|"non-breaking", message }
function compareSchema(schemaId, baseline, current): { breaking: string[], nonBreaking: string[] }

## src/schemas/agent.ts

AgentSessionStatusSchema: ZodEnum<PENDING|CANCELLED|RUNNING|SUCCEEDED|FAILED>
AgentSessionSchema: ZodObject (id, status, taskDescription, branchName, baseBranch, model, maxTurns, maxBudgetUsd, prUrl, prNumber, resultText, costUsd, inputTokens, outputTokens, numTurns, durationMs, parentId, errors, startedAt, completedAt, createdAt, updatedAt)
CreateAgentSessionRequestSchema: ZodObject (taskDescription, model?, maxTurns?, maxBudgetUsd?, baseBranch?, parentId?)
